hook: BYD says the Seagull charges from 10% to 70% in five minutes.
hooks: The BYD Seagull can charge from 10% to 70% in five minutes.
It can fill most of its battery in five minutes.
BYD says the Seagull charges from 10% to 70% in five minutes.
what_happened: BYD's updated Seagull hatchback can, it claims, charge from 10% to 70% in five minutes on its Flash Charging system.
why_it_matters: If BYD's claim holds, a five-minute stop could take the battery from 10% to 70%, but only at its dedicated stations.
the_catch: Flash Charging only comes on the top three trims and needs BYD's dedicated stations, which are effectively China-only for now.
caption: BYD claims the Seagull EV hatchback charges from 10% to 70% in five minutes using its Flash Charging system. Five minutes enough?
alt_text: The slides explain that the BYD Seagull EV can charge from 10% to 70% in five minutes, needs special stations, and the limitation of current availability.

es.hook: BYD dice que el Seagull carga del 10 % al 70 % en cinco minutos.
es.what_happened: BYD afirma que su Seagull hatchback actualizado puede cargar del 10 % al 70 % en cinco minutos con su sistema Flash Charging.
es.why_it_matters: Si la afirmación de BYD es cierta, una parada de cinco minutos podría llevar la batería del 10 % al 70 %, pero solo en sus estaciones dedicadas.
es.the_catch: Flash Charging solo está disponible en los tres niveles de equipamiento más altos y requiere las estaciones dedicadas de BYD, que por ahora están prácticamente solo en China.
